newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Pharmacare expands into Kenya.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Pharmacare expands into Kenya.

text.p: South African Druggists unit Pharmacare Ltd said on Thursday it has expanded its operations into Kenya by appointing Surgipharm Ltd as its agent for the east African country.
The deal means Surgipharm will market and distribute a wide range of Pharmacare products in Kenya.
"Our intention is to have a significant presence in Africa and the Middle East," said Pharmacare general manager Chris van Niekerk.
"Not only do these areas represent lucrative markets, but they fit into our long-term strategy of providing affordable health care internationally," he added.
The company is currently in talks about an export agreement with Dubai in the United Arab Emirates.
The move into Kenya adds to a long list of African countries where Pharmacare products are already registered that range from Uganda to Mozambique.
